answer_1.quote: Sentence simplification aims to reduce the linguistic complexity of a text whilst retaining most of its meaning. ... We evaluate our model using English as our high-resource language and German as our low-resource language ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model output using a combination of four automatically-generated scores. ... BLEU_T, I-BLEU_T,S, SARI_T,S, FRE-BLEU_T,S,R

answer_4.quote: We also evaluated system output by eliciting human judgments via Amazon's Mechanical Turk. Native German speakers ... were asked to rate simplifications on three dimensions: Grammaticality, Meaning Adequacy, and Simplicity.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each simplification on Grammaticality, Meaning Adequacy, and Simplicity using a five‑point Likert scale.
